mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_execution SET delete_flag=0,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND delete_flag=1
UPDATE ai_agent_execution SET agent_name=#{agentName},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND delete_flag=1
mapper.select: SELECT e.id,e.run_id AS runId,e.conversation_id AS conversationId, e.parent_execution_id AS parentExecutionId,p.run_id AS parentRunId, e.agent_name AS agentName,e.delegation_tool_call_id AS delegationToolCallId, e.task,e.status,e.error_code AS errorCode, DATE_FORMAT(e.finished_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS finishedAt, DATE_FORMAT(e.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM ai_agent_execution e LEFT JOIN ai_agent_execution p ON p.id=e.parent_execution_id WHERE e.user_id=#{userId} AND e.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND e.delete_flag=1 ORDER BY e.created_at,e.id

SELECT e.id,e.run_id AS runId,e.conversation_id AS conversationId, e.parent_execution_id AS parentExecutionId,p.run_id AS parentRunId, e.agent_name AS agentName,e.delegation_tool_call_id AS delegationToolCallId, e.task,e.status,e.error_code AS errorCode, DATE_FORMAT(e.finished_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS finishedAt, DATE_FORMAT(e.created_at,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM ai_agent_execution e LEFT JOIN ai_agent_execution p ON p.id=e.parent_execution_id WHERE e.user_id=#{userId} AND e.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND e.run_id=#{runId} AND e.delete_flag=1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent_execution SET status=#{status},error_code=#{errorCode}, finished_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND delete_flag=1
